title: rotation
description: Rotation showcase 9x7: open arena with a central pillar. Every agent (NPCs included) spawns in rotation movement mode, so it turns in place with left/right and advances with up; the standard-mode autorotation faces the movement direction. The shooter plugin fires a laser beam along the agent's facing: it stops on the first agent in line, who loses one point. Rows are listed top-to-bottom while internal y grows upward.
